verify.note: A download route establishes the caller and opens a door that compares the caller to download_policy, records one library_downloads row before it answers and refuses when it cannot, and signs a protected original for at most a minute; the migration set creates the table with no insert, update or delete policy; the drawer goes through the route and no longer fetches in the browser. Fails on main at the first arm (no route). Cannot see the applied state (check:migrations) or a real redirect.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1596). PREMISE RE-TESTED FIRST (ADR-1082) on the LIVE-577 tree at 8df84fe36, from the repo only: the drawer's Download called downloadImageUrl(asset.url), a browser fetch with a window.open fallback; nothing under app/api/library existed; download_policy was compared to no caller; no table recorded a download; and with LIVE-577 the url a protected row carries in the Studio is a one-hour signed original, so the button handed that hour to the browser. The premise held. BUILT: app/api/library/download/[id]/route.ts establishes the caller (getCallerProfile) and hands off to openLibraryDownload in lib/library/download-door.ts, which refuses a malformed id, a missing row or a row with no file (404) and an expired license for everyone (410), applies the policy (open: anyone with the link; members: a signed-in profile, else 401; staff: authorizeAction(caller, janitor, marketing), the answered twin of the Studio gate, else 403), mints (a 60-second signed attachment from library-private for a protected original through signedLibraryAssetUrl, which gained an optional download name; the public url with storage's download flag otherwise), inserts ONE public.library_downloads row, and only then answers 302 with no-store. A failed insert refuses (503) and the minted URL is never sent; a failed mint refuses and writes nothing. MIGRATION 20270345009560_library_downloads.sql (FILE ONLY, applied by the orchestrator before the fold): id, asset_id on delete cascade, profile_id on delete set null, policy text, created_at; RLS on; one policy, staff select through private.get_my_web_role(); no insert, update or delete policy; revoke all from anon and insert/update/delete/truncate from authenticated. supabase/tests/library_downloads.test.sql proves no write policy exists, anon and a member read nothing and write nothing, staff read the row and cannot insert, update or delete it, and the row follows its asset on delete. Gate lists: scripts/table-grants.txt (authenticated), scripts/admin-client-baseline.txt (the door), lib/database.types.ts (the table). The drawer's Download is a link to the door and shows the record under [data-loom-downloads] through a Studio-gated action (libraryDownloadRecord); downloadImageUrl is deleted (a code-drawn element exports from the DOM). TESTS: lib/library/download-door.test.ts (each policy against each caller, the one-minute sign, record-before-answer and refusal on a failed write, expiry, missing, a failed mint, the pure filename and url helpers). PROBE: passes on this tree, fails on main at the first arm (no route), and each of seven arms was mutation-fired (ttl 3600, no insert, a swallowed insert error, no staff gate, an update policy on the table, the drawer bypassing the route, the caller read after the door). OWNER: nothing beyond the migration apply.
